info.title: Forever Companion API
info.description: Read-only data on WoW Forever: dungeons, quests, items, rares, zones, reputations and class quests. No key needed; 120 requests per 60 seconds per IP. Docs: https://forevercompanion.io/developers. Fan-made, not affiliated with Blizzard Entertainment.

get.description: What's available: every endpoint, when the data was last synced, the rate limit and the data sources.

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

get.description: Every dungeon with its level range, zone, bosses and how many quests and drops it has. Use the dungeon endpoint for the quests and loot themselves.

parameters.name: faction
parameters.description: Only what this faction can do (results marked for both factions are included).

parameters.name: minLevel
parameters.description: Only dungeons that are open at this level or higher.

parameters.name: maxLevel
parameters.description: Only dungeons that are open at this level or lower.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only names containing this text (case-insensitive).

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

get.description: One dungeon in full: its quests (with XP, rewards and prerequisites), bosses, loot and notes.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The dungeon's id, as in its page address (`wailing-caverns`).

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

get.description: Dungeon quests and elite (group) quests, with XP, level, faction, rewards and prerequisites.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only dungeon quests, or only elite (group) quests.

parameters.name: dungeon
parameters.description: Only this dungeon's quests (its id).

parameters.name: faction
parameters.description: Only what this faction can do (results marked for both factions are included).

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Only quests this class can do (`warrior`, `priest`, …); class-only quests for other classes are left out.

parameters.name: minLevel
parameters.description: Only quests at this level or higher.

parameters.name: maxLevel
parameters.description: Only quests at this level or lower.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only names containing this text (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (default 100, at most 500).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many results to skip, for the next page (see `page.next`).

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

get.description: One quest by its game quest id (the number in its Wowhead address).

parameters.name: questId
parameters.description: The game's quest id.

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

get.description: Item summaries: quality, item level, required level, slot, armor type and stats. Covers every item the site knows (dungeon loot, quest and reputation rewards).

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Only these item ids, comma-separated.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Only this quality.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: Only this slot (`Head`, `Chest`, `Two-Hand`, …).

parameters.name: minLevel
parameters.description: Only items whose required level is at least this.

parameters.name: maxLevel
parameters.description: Only items whose required level is at most this.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only names containing this text (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page (default 100, at most 500).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: How many results to skip, for the next page (see `page.next`).

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

get.description: One item: its summary, full tooltip lines, which dungeons drop it and which quests reward it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The game's item id.

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

get.description: Rare spawns with their zone, levels, coordinates and drops.

parameters.name: zone
parameters.description: Only rares in this zone (its name).

parameters.name: faction
parameters.description: Only what this faction can do (results marked for both factions are included).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only names containing this text (case-insensitive).

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

get.description: Questing zones with their level range and who they're for.

parameters.name: faction
parameters.description: Only what this faction can do (results marked for both factions are included).

parameters.name: minLevel
parameters.description: Only zones that overlap at this level or higher.

parameters.name: maxLevel
parameters.description: Only zones that overlap at this level or lower.

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

get.description: Reputations new to Forever (Waylaid Supplies, Merchant's Favor): how to earn them, standings and every reward with its cost.

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

get.description: Quests that unlock class abilities and notable items, by class and level.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: Only this class's quests.

parameters.name: faction
parameters.description: Only what this faction can do (results marked for both factions are included).

429.description: Over the rate limit (120 requests per 60 seconds per IP). Wait and retry.

endpoints.description: Every endpoint: `path`, `summary`, `url` of an example request.

DungeonSummary.description: A dungeon without its quests and loot.

access.description: `alliance` or `horde` when the entrance is in a faction capital the other side can't realistically reach.

betaLocked.description: Not open in the beta yet.

questCount.description: How many quests it has (both factions).

questId.description: The game's quest id; missing for the few quests not matched to the game yet.

minLevel.description: Level needed to pick it up.

classes.description: Only these classes can do it.

xpEstimated.description: The XP is estimated from Classic's, not seen in Forever yet.

dungeon.description: `{ id, name }` of its dungeon (dungeon quests).

rewards.description: `{ items: [{ id, name }], choice }`: reward items, and whether you choose one.

prerequisites.description: Quests to do first, earliest first; each step's quests (`{ questId, name }`) are done side by side.

verified.description: What players' games confirmed through the Forever Companion app.

url.description: Where it is on Forever Companion.

classicOnly.description: Only Classic's stats are known; not seen in Forever yet.

verified.description: How many players' games confirmed its quality, item level and level requirement.

tooltip.description: Tooltip lines as in game: `{ left, right?, kind, changed? }`. `kind` is `plain`, `green`, `set`, `bonus`, `muted` or `flavor`; `changed` marks lines that differ from Classic.

dropsFrom.description: `{ dungeon: { id, name }, source }`: dungeons that drop it, and the boss when known.

rewardFrom.description: `{ questId, name, type }`: quests that reward it.

Loot.description: One drop in a dungeon's loot table.

source.description: Who drops it (a boss), when known.

coords.description: Spawn points as `x, y` map coordinates.

verified.description: How many players' games saw it.

race.description: Only this race can reach it (Zephras Isle is Skyborne-only).

factionNames.description: Its name on each side: `{ alliance?, horde? }`.

currency.description: What rewards cost, if not reputation itself.

rewards.description: `{ itemId, name, kind, profession?, skill?, cost, standing? }`.

ClassQuest.description: A quest that unlocks a class ability or item.

Verified.description: Confirmed in game: at least three players' games reported the same values.

updatedAt.description: When the game data was last synced (ISO 8601), or null.

sources.description: The sites the data comes from: `[{ name, url }]`.

next.description: The URL of the next page, or null on the last one.
